content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Sanathnagar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Sanathnagar?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled to be held on 16th, 17th, and 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in the ESIC Sanathnagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Sanathnagar?
faq.answer: ESIC Sanathnagar has announced a total of 26 vacancies for the mentioned posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is as per Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations 2025, with a preference for Post Graduates in Critical Care for certain roles.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Professor post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Professor post is Rs. 2,59,515/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates need to appear for a walk-in interview with all required documents and a filled application form.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Required documents include passport-size photographs, testimonials, proof of age, identity proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ESIC Super Specialty Hospital Sanathnagar located?
faq.answer: The hospital is located in Sanathnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500038.
